wa_west_face_7_heretic_s_highway.notes: NOT A DUPLICATE of wa_drill_s_thrill_aka_heretic_s_highway. On MP they are two routes by the same party (Linthwaite, G. and K. Silverman, Baylor, spring 2019): Drill's Thrill is a 90 ft single-pitch sport line (5.11b, FFA Feb 2021 Bedell & Cote); Heretic's Highway is a 3-pitch 5.7 A1 whose first pitch uses Drill's Thrill's bolts as a ladder, then moves the belay about 30 ft right and continues. They share pitch 1 only. CATALOG DEFECT on the other row: its name '(aka Heretic's Highway)' is wrong (MP gives no aka), it stores 5.11b/c where MP says 5.11b, and pitches 0. Reported, not fixed (not my row). Aid grade A1 matches MP. FA (MP: Spring 2019, Eric Linthwaite, Geoff Silverman, Kyle Silverman, Adam Baylor) not set from MP alone; row stores none.
